# ArmCare

> > ArmCare is a comprehensive baseball arm health and performance platform featuring the ArmCare Sensor, mobile app, and Coaches Portal for data-driven injury prevention and velocity training.

ArmCare provides integrated solutions for players, coaches, and teams to monitor arm strength, prevent injuries like Tommy John surgery, and optimize throwing performance through biomechanics education, personalized training programs, and real-time fatigue tracking. The platform combines hardware (ArmCare Sensor, Crossover Symmetry equipment) with software (mobile apps, team management portal) and expert-led courses from MLB professionals.

## Key Topics

- ArmCare Sensor
- Coaches Portal
- Injury Prevention
- Tommy John Prevention
- Velocity Training
- Arm Strength Assessment
- Fatigue Tracking
- Team Management
- Baseball Pitching Biomechanics
- Crossover Symmetry
- Athlete Recovery
- Certified ArmCare Specialist Course
- MLB Performance Training
- Shoulder Strength
- Individualized Pitch Counts

## Core Platform & Products

- [ArmCare Coaches Portal](https://armcare.com/products/armcare-coaches-portal): Team management hub for monitoring player arm health and development
- [Players](https://armcare.com/pages/players): Player-focused ArmCare platform with Assessment Package, App, and metrics
- [Coaches](https://armcare.com/pages/coaches): Coaches Portal with Strength Sensor and Certified Specialist Course by Dr. Crotin
- [Assessment Package - Pocket Radar](https://armcare.com/en-ca/pages/arm-care-pocket-radar): Assessment Package with Pocket Radar and ArmCare Sensor for velocity training
- [Premium App Upgrade (18 Months)](https://armcare.com/products/premium-app-upgrade): 18-month Premium subscription with Arm Primer and performance tracking
- [Crossover Symmetry TORQ System](https://armcare.com/en-ca/products/torq-system): Crossover Symmetry TORQ System for rotational power and core training

## Team & Coaching Solutions

- [Team Subscription Options](https://armcare.com/en-ca/pages/team-subscription-options): Team and facility pricing plans with Coaches Portal and SPEAR Training
- [Coach and Team ArmCare](https://armcare.com/pages/individualized-pitch-counts-copy): Team Management Software for pitcher health and individualized training
- [ArmCare Accelerator Program](https://armcare.com/pages/accelerator-jan-11-product-page): ArmCare Accelerator program for data-driven injury prevention and recovery

## Education & Training Courses

- [ArmCare Pitching Biomechanist Course](https://armcare.com/products/2131623): Biomechanics course by Brian Bannister & Ken Knutson for pitching evaluation
- [Bulletproof Arm - Major League Performance & Recovery Habits](https://armcare.com/en-ca/products/2429064): Ryan Crotin's Great-8 Performance Process course on recovery and nutrition

## Injury Prevention & Performance

- [How to Prevent Tommy John](https://armcare.com/en-ca/pages/how-to-prevent-tommy-john): UCL injury prevention guide featuring Crossover Symmetry and ArmCare plan
- [Velocity Gains Success Story](https://armcare.com/pages/velocity-gains): Joe Beimel's velocity training success story with ArmCare Sensor and App
- [Pitch Logic Partnership](https://armcare.com/en-ca/pages/pitch-logic-partnership): Partnership integrating Pitch Logic with ArmCare Sensor for pitch tracking
